articles.title: Ex-president named leader of new DR Congo rebel coalition
DR Congo: Kabila’s move towards M23 raises questions over peace

events.summary: Former DR Congo president Joseph Kabila has been named leader of a new rebel coalition aligned with M23. Kabila previously denied any links to the rebel group that controls significant parts of eastern DR Congo.
events.why: A former head of state officially joining an active rebel group severely threatens national governance and peace efforts across Central and East Africa.

articles.title: Hungarian MPs scrap Orbán's anti-LGBTQ measures

events.summary: Hungarian lawmakers have repealed anti-LGBTQ legislation previously established under Prime Minister Viktor Orbán. Civil rights activists welcomed the repeal while urging broader legal revisions.
events.why: Repealing flagship socially restrictive legislation represents a major legal and human rights reversal in a European Union member state.

articles.title: Riyadh airport hit again after deadly Houthi missile attack, Saudi authorities say

events.summary: A projectile struck a passenger terminal at Riyadh's King Khalid airport, killing one person and injuring 11. Authorities warn the escalating attacks threaten to draw additional countries into the Yemen conflict.
events.why: Fatal strikes on civilian international terminals mark a severe escalation in regional cross-border warfare.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia further suspends flights after latest deadly Houthi attack on airport

events.summary: Saudi Arabia has suspended all flights to and from its main international airport following another deadly Houthi attack. The paramilitary strike breached Saudi air defenses.
events.why: Targeting commercial aviation infrastructure threatens regional transport hubs and risks further escalating the regional conflict.

articles.title: Missiles intercepted near Riyadh after Saudi coalition hits Yemen fuel depot
Saudi Arabia strikes oil depots in Yemen and says missiles launched toward location of Saudi Aramco HQ

events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition struck a fuel depot near Sanaa in Yemen. Concurrently, missiles targeting Saudi Aramco headquarters were intercepted near Riyadh.
events.why: Direct strikes and counter-strikes on energy infrastructure threaten both local stability and international oil supplies.

articles.title: BBC FM radio transmissions suspended in Afghanistan

events.summary: BBC FM radio transmissions have been suspended in Afghanistan. Broadcaster programming remains available to Afghan audiences via shortwave, medium wave, satellite, and online platforms.
events.why: Shuts down a primary local transmission channel for independent news under Taliban rule, further restricting access to information.

articles.title: Argentina targets UK in legal claim over Falklands oil exploration

events.summary: Argentina has filed a legal claim with an international maritime tribunal against the UK concerning Falklands oil exploration. The filing marks an escalation in the ongoing territorial dispute over the islands.
events.why: Formal international maritime tribunal proceedings over resource rights could reshape long-standing bilateral maritime claims.

articles.title: Indian opposition figures lead march to police barricades around supreme court

events.summary: Thousands joined an opposition-led rally in Delhi marching toward the Supreme Court to demand the resignation of India's election commissioner. Delhi police obstructed the protests following mass unrest.
events.why: Public and opposition challenges to national election oversight pose serious risks to institutional legitimacy in the world's most populous democracy.

articles.title: Watch: Emergency calls from botched Christa Pike execution released

events.summary: Emergency call recordings obtained by the Associated Press show that emergency responders faced delays reaching Christa Pike during a botched execution. Pike's execution has faced scrutiny over protocol execution.
events.why: Evidence of botched execution protocols frequently triggers judicial reviews and potential moratoria on capital punishment.
